description: The settings.get happy path (S44 T5): one declared key returns its full SettingView. Here test.count has a stored row, so the EFFECTIVE value is the stored value with source="database" and stored non-null. get is the read the UI opens a setting row with and the CLI reads back after a set; it answers the store's own resolution (env → database → default) field for field, so the app never re-derives precedence (CS10's one-resolution rule). A key the registry does not declare refuses with settings.get's unknown code, not a silent default.
